title: Map next owner-evidence gap
prompt: Inspect current commercial summary, owner handoff, completion drill, closeout status, and verifier coverage to identify one bounded repo-side gap that can be improved without owner-held evidence.
summary: Mapped current commercial gate state and selected manual WCAG packet source-audit as the next bounded owner-evidence hardening lever.

title: Implement selected bounded slice
prompt: Apply the smallest safe repo-side patch that improves owner evidence readiness or proof-boundary verification without changing gate truth or adding dependencies.
summary: Implemented direct manual WCAG review packet source-audit verifier, fixtures, package scripts, release wiring, summary alignment, and trust-boundary coverage.

title: Challenge evidence boundary
prompt: Run focused checks and try to refute any claim that the patch proves owner-held evidence, live revenue, manual WCAG conformance, production closeout, or commercial-ready status.
summary: Verified direct source audit, packet-to-audit URL drift fixtures, full commercial verifier, network source-audit verifier, refreshed trust scan, and diff hygiene.

title: Record phase handoff
prompt: Record ECC phase ledger with baseline, delta, checks, reflection, decision, and next adjustment.
summary: Recorded phase-loop ledger and preserved launch decision as pilot-only with five owner-held gates remaining.
